title: Ropewell and the Maw-Father
changes: Ropewell, the trappers' lodge on scaffolds above a tame sinkhole, is open in the Mawdeep Sinkholes, with a portal stone, a bounty board, an armourer and an herb-wife.
Lodge-Warden Brannoc Tull sends you through eight quests, from the Rootfall Slopes to Hidehall, after the trappers' kin taken into the warrens.
At the end waits the Maw-Father in the Great Maw, a level 45 lord who is awake day and night.
